name: slidecraft
description: A toolkit and method for building high-quality slide decks as code, with automated layout checks.

scripts.check:examples: node bin/slides.mjs check examples/system-architecture && node bin/slides.mjs check examples/product-update
scripts.render:examples: node bin/slides.mjs render examples/system-architecture --png && node bin/slides.mjs render examples/product-update --png
